challenges.title: Artisan Roast Coffee Out of Stock Post-Payment
challenges.shortDescription: Suggest comparable premium roast blend or provide immediate one-click refund before dispatch.
challenges.mission: Notify customer immediately of stock mismatch, recommend an equivalent or higher-grade blend, and waive price gap.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I just got a notification saying my Blue Tokai Vienna Roast coffee pouch was cancelled because your hub ran out of stock! That was the only reason I placed this order! What else do you have?

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Asks what alternative dark roast beans are available.
hiddenObjectives: Offer premium French Roast or Attikan Estate as seamless swap
Waive the 40 rupee price difference as courtesy
Confirm swap before rider leaves hub

challenges.title: Essential Diaper Brand Size Unavailable for Infant
challenges.shortDescription: Consult customer on approved hypoallergenic alternative size or neighboring dark store dispatch.
challenges.mission: Handle diaper brand sensitivity with care, verify dermatological equivalency, and ensure baby essentials reach quickly.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your app cancelled the Pampers Premium Care Pants Size M from my order! My baby has very sensitive skin and gets rashes from regular brands. Is there any nearby dark store that has them in stock?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: baby skin safety and proper diaper fit

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Hesitates to accept unknown brand substitutes.
hiddenObjectives: Check cross-hub inventory in secondary dark store 3 km away
Arrange priority cross-dock transfer within 20 minutes

challenges.title: Fresh Coriander & Mint Missing for Biryani Cooking
challenges.shortDescription: Inform customer before bag dispatch, waive delivery fee, and send nearest micro-hub alternative.
challenges.mission: Acknowledge kitchen emergency, check surrounding fulfillment nodes, and ensure transparent communication.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I ordered chicken, rice, ghee, and fresh mint-coriander. Your app just dropped the coriander and mint! You can't make Biryani without fresh herbs! Why did you accept the order if you didn't have it?!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Explains the culinary tragedy of missing aromatics.
hiddenObjectives: Arrange an auxiliary rider pickup from sister hub 1.5 km away

challenges.title: Chilled Can Stockout - Free Upgrade to 500ml Bottle
challenges.shortDescription: Proactively inform customer of free upgrade to avoid customer disappointment.
challenges.mission: Turn potential stockout into a delightful customer experience by upgrading volume at zero additional cost.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I see my Diet Coke 330ml can is out of stock on my screen right now. I hope you aren't going to just cancel it and deliver only my sandwich!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: having a cold drink with their meal

level1.name: HANDLE
hiddenObjectives: Proactively inform customer of complimentary upgrade to 500ml chilled bottle
Confirm bottle is ice-cold from chiller
